datasets.title: Abell 1689 in visible light
datasets.description: Hubble's Advanced Camera for Surveys view of Abell 1689 in visible and near-infrared light, with the blue arcs of background galaxies its gravity distorts. It stands as one flat picture facing the Sun at the cluster's distance.
datasets.summary: Hubble's visible and near-infrared view of the cluster and its lensed arcs. A flat picture of the sky, with no depth.
